game: MIN@GB Week 12 2025, kickoff 2025-11-23 13:00 ET, Lambeau outdoors

script.base: Books have GB -6.5 with a 24.0 implied total and MIN at 17.5 on a 41.5 total, so Green Bay leads by about a score late and wants to close on the ground with Josh Jacobs if the knee allows, otherwise Emanuel Wilson. Minnesota, as a 6.5-point dog, falls into more J.J. McCarthy dropbacks and fewer Aaron Jones and Jordan Mason carries after halftime. Pace stays moderate outdoors, not a shootout.
script.flip1: Minnesota hangs in it. Jones (34 carries, 195 yards over weeks 9-11) and Mason keep the Vikings on schedule against a GB defense that blitzes only 23%, McCarthy's legs (10/65 in that span) steal some rushes, and Mason's under is the leg that gets stressed.
script.flip2: GB scores early and it becomes a two-score game. MIN pass attempts spike but McCarthy's EPA stays negative (-0.26 per dropback vs the blitz, -0.08 clean), so targets do not become yards; GB then runs the clock and, if it gets ugly, Jacobs and Romeo Doubs lose late snaps while Wilson mops up.

injury_fallout: Source: nflverse pre-game injury report plus week 9-11 usage in the pack. No final inactives. GB WR Jayden Reed is Out (foot), so Doubs is already the lead target (22 targets, 149 yards in weeks 9-11). Wicks (Questionable, calf; 10/47), Golden (Questionable, shoulder; 6/33) and Savion Williams (Questionable, foot; 5/47) could concentrate what is left onto Doubs and Luke Musgrave (8/56). Tucker Kraft is not on the report but is absent from the week 9-11 target list and has a median from only 8 games, so a full TE role is unconfirmed. Jacobs is Questionable (knee); if he is limited, Wilson (18 carries, 58 yards in that span; last4 rush 61, 16, 2, 40) is next man up, not an automatic bellcow. CB Nate Hobbs is Out (knee), so a backup covers someone in the MIN receiver group, alignment not charted. LB Quay Walker is Doubtful (neck), which helps Hockenson and Jones as receivers and weakens run fits. DT Karl Brooks (Questionable, ankle) and DE Lukas Van Ness (Questionable, foot) are the other front-seven doubts on GB's season rush rate. MIN C Ryan Kelly is Questionable (concussion): if he sits, pressure and quick throws rise. MIN LB Jonathan Greenard is Questionable (shoulder): if he sits, Love has more time against a blitz-heavy defense he already beats.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Location YPA is the proxy. GB allows 7.34 YPA in the middle (88 attempts) versus 5.62 left (117) and 5.61 right (140), so the relative hole is the hook and middle, not the outside. MIN allows 10.69 YPA in the middle (68) versus 6.93 left (110) and 5.64 right (105).
matchup.pressure: GB blitz rate 23%. McCarthy is worse vs the blitz (EPA/db -0.26) than clean (-0.08), so GB's low blitz rate avoids his worst split, but he is still negative clean. MIN blitz rate 51%. Love is better vs the blitz (+0.35 EPA/db) than clean (+0.23), so Minnesota's pressure identity has been feeding him, not killing him.
matchup.bleeds: GB run defense does not bleed: 3.86 YPC and only 17 runs of 10+ in 10 games. GB has allowed 21 passes of 20+ for 369 yards. MIN run defense does bleed explosives: 4.22 YPC and 34 runs of 10+ in 10 games, plus 23 passes of 20+ for 309 yards, with the middle at 10.69 YPA the soft spot.
matchup.overlap: The real overlap is GB's pass game into MIN's 51% blitz and 10.69 middle YPA. Doubs is the target leader with Reed out, but his recent yards do not clear 54.5 cleanly and a GB lead can stall a WR. Jefferson (30 targets, 145 yards, 353 air yards over three games) is MIN's primary, and GB's outside YPA near 5.6 is not that hole; Hobbs being out muddies the defender. Mason does not attack a weak front. He runs into the strong one, which is the under.

form: Using weeks 9-11 and last-4 lines, not season averages. Mason is the RB2: 20 carries, 106 yards, 2 targets, 7 yards over three games, last4 rush 3, 36, 25, 45, all under the 48.5 median stand-in, while Jones has the lead share (34/195 rush, 14/53 receiving; last4 rush 15, 78, 47, 70). Jefferson's last4 receiving is 74, 47, 37, 61 against a 74.5 median, with 353 air yards producing only 145 yards. Addison is 22 targets, 103 yards, 367 air. Hockenson last4 is 26, 11, 8, 39. Jacobs last4 rush is 33, 87, 74, 40 (L3 45/201) with a questionable knee and Wilson already at 18/58. Doubs last4 is 44, 91, 5, 53, and 91+5+53 equals his 149-yard three-game total. Kraft has no listed targets in weeks 9-11.

pro_edge.implied_totals: GB 24.0 and MIN 17.5, matching (41.5+6.5)/2 and (41.5-6.5)/2 and the PRO-EDGE INPUTS block.
pro_edge.script_read: A 6.5 spread is a lead-and-run for GB, not a 14-point blowout flag, so the lead back's late carries rise only if Jacobs is actually active. MIN as a dog of more than 3.5 should throw more, which cuts Jones and Mason rush volume and lifts WR, TE and RB targets. A 41.5 total is moderate, not a shootout volume-over spot. Outdoor weather was not saved, so no wind or rain lean.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price was saved on any prop from Jefferson 74.5 through Golden 24.5. Anchor no-vig is N/A. No book can be shown beating Pinnacle, Circa or BetOnline. Power devig versus overround is unavailable.
pro_edge.lagging: No open, consensus or book-versus-book movement file. Cannot flag a lagging line. Reed, Hobbs, Walker and a questionable Jacobs are the news items that should have moved props; no post-news diff is in the pack.
pro_edge.sleepers: Out or Doubtful, not merely questionable: Reed (WR, foot), Hobbs (CB, knee), Walker (LB, neck). Reed's same-position teammates with props are Doubs (recyds 54.5) and Golden (24.5, himself Questionable). Kraft (49.5) is the TE sleeper candidate only if he is active after zero listed targets in weeks 9-11; Musgrave has the recent TE usage (8/56) and has no prop. Hobbs out theoretically helps Jefferson, Addison and Nailor against a backup, alignment unknown, and those lines cannot be shown as unmoved. Walker doubtful theoretically helps Hockenson and Jones receiving. Jacobs is Questionable, not Out, so Wilson (rush 17.5) is a conditional handcuff, not a confirmed sleeper. Kelly and Greenard are Questionable on the MIN side.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Mason is the secondary back behind a healthy Jones, Green Bay has allowed 3.86 yards per carry and only 17 runs of 10-plus in 10 games, and a 6.5-point dog script cuts his carries further, so 48.5 is above what he has done in every one of his last four games.
edge_players.must_be_true: Jones plays and keeps the lead share he has had over the last three games (34 carries to Mason's 20), Mason is not suddenly the closer, and GB's front is not wiped out by the Walker, Brooks and Van Ness statuses.
edge_players.kills_it: Jones sits or is scripted out and Mason inherits a 12-plus carry day, or Walker, Brooks and Van Ness all miss and one of the rare 10-plus runs GB allows becomes a 25-yarder that pushes him through 48.5 in a close game.

matchup.source: GB defense, 10 games in the pack: 3.86 rush YPC, 17 runs of 10+ yards. This week's front health is only a caveat, not a confirmed downgrade.

scheme_fit.source: MIN weeks 9-11: Jones 34 carries/195 yards, Mason 20/106 and only 2 targets. Mason is the RB2, not the passing-down back.

script.source: Closing line GB -6.5, MIN implied 17.5. Pro-edge rule: a dog of 3.5+ throws more and the trail script cuts RB carries. A blowout flip cuts them further. The close-game flip is the one that stresses this under, and 48.5 still needs a carry spike.

form_trend.source: Mason last4 rush yards 3, 36, 25, 45, all under 48.5. Three-game rate 35.3 yards. The 48.5 figure is his 10-game median stand-in, which overweights games before Jones's 6-game sample.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim file or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot size a rung against a sharp price. The 48.5 stand-in is Mason's 10-game median, not a shopped line. Recent role with Jones agrees with the under (hand estimate 0.62, not a sim; do not treat as a calibrated 70%+). Flag, do not cut: Walker is Doubtful and Brooks and Van Ness are Questionable, so the 3.86 YPC season rate may be softer on Sunday, and weather is unknown. Passed, not flagged as legs: Jefferson under 74.5 (last4 all at or under, but Hobbs is Out and a dog throw-more script makes the counter-case as strong as the read) and Doubs over 54.5 (matchup overlap is real, but L3 yards split like 91, 5 and 53 and a GB lead can stall the WR, so a lean the recent yards do not support gets dropped).

market_rung_price: Jordan Mason rushing yards under 48.5. No price saved, no alt rung, no short-priced alternate. Anchor no-vig N/A, so nothing to shop.
pre_mortem: It is Monday and Mason under lost because Walker, Brooks and Van Ness all sat, Green Bay's run fits broke, Minnesota stayed within a score, and Mason turned a 9-carry day plus one explosive into the mid-50s. That counter needs several front-seven absences and a run length this defense has rarely allowed. It is real, and it is why this is a lean rather than a strong, but it is not stronger than the role math: about 7 carries at even a softened 4.5 yards per carry still lands near 30, well under 48.5.
slip_story: One story only: GB controls a moderate 41.5 outdoor game and Minnesota cannot sustain a two-back rushing attack, so the RB2 rush under is the leg. Do not pair it with a MIN rush over, a Jones rushrec over, or a same-game total over. No second leg. Jefferson under and Doubs over were considered and passed.
